candidates.name: Mycosis fungoides
support_spans: pruritic, dark red plaque on his right upper eyelid
perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates around cystically dilated follicular infundibula
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a pruritic, dark red plaque on the eyelid, along with the histopathologic findings of perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates, is consistent with Mycosis fungoides.

candidates.name: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
support_spans: erythematous, violaceous, indurated, scaly plaque with some papules on his right upper eyelid
monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement was demonstrated
candidates.why: The patient's clinical presentation and histopathologic findings, including the presence of a monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, support the diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

candidates.name: Sézary syndrome
support_spans: atypical lymphocytes into the epithelium
CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
candidates.why: The presence of atypical lymphocytes in the epithelium and an abnormal CD4 to CD8 cell ratio suggests a mechanism involving T-cell dysregulation, as seen in Sézary syndrome.
